read_tag_from_buffer: read a protobuf wire tag from a serialized buffer at a given position and return the raw tag bytes
skip_field_by_tag: skip a protobuf field in a serialized buffer using its tag bytes and return the new position
decode_varint_field: decode a varint-encoded integer field from a protobuf buffer using Int32Decoder or UInt64Decoder
decode_string_or_bytes_field: decode a length-delimited string or bytes field from a protobuf buffer using StringDecoder or BytesDecoder
decode_nested_message_field: decode a nested protobuf message or group field from a buffer using MessageDecoder or GroupDecoder
